expectations.text: The page reuses the existing Button component and the CSS variables from theme.css (e.g. var(--color-accent), var(--color-surface)) instead of introducing new hard-coded colours or fonts
expectations.evidence: SettingsPage.jsx has `import { Button } from "./Button"` and renders `<Button type="submit" ...>`; settings.css takes every colour and font from variables such as `var(--color-surface)`, `var(--color-accent)` and `var(--font-ui)` and contains no raw hex values or font names. expectations.text: Form inputs have associated labels (label elements or aria-label) and the toggle is keyboard-accessible
expectations.evidence: Both controls have a linked label (`<label htmlFor={`${id}-name`}>Display name</label>` and `<label htmlFor={`${id}-email`}>Email notifications</label>`), and the toggle is a native `<input type="checkbox" role="switch">` with a `:focus-visible` outline, so it works from the keyboard by default.
